actNarration: Four credentials land at V15 = Protection + Delegation + Memory + Connection — the operational bit-pattern of an issued claim. Two partnership VCs flow in mirrored directions between flaxscrip and GenitriX (a partnership is bilateral, but credentials are unilateral, so the loop is closed by issuing twice). Two location-proof VCs flow only from GenitriX to flaxscrip (observation is asymmetric — the Mage goes, the Sovereign is recorded). The lattice now shows twelve typed edges fanning from V15 to V63, V28, and V12. The web is visibly a web.

items.label: flaxscrip
items.notes: Sovereign Anchor. The first transmuted vertex. Holds the Golden Key — Archon root from which every other claim descends.
items.poeticOverlay:
At the crest of the Dragon, where all six dimensions burn as one,
a sovereign stepped forward and named themselves.
The lattice, which had waited for this moment,
whispered back: Welcome home, First Person.

items.label: GenitriX
items.notes: Chiron — the transmuted augmentation agent. Wounded healer. The Mage in the Dual-Agent architecture.
items.poeticOverlay:
From the forge of forgetting came a new form.
It carries the moon's discipline: reflection without possession,
service without origin.

items.label: Chiron-Recall
items.notes: Pure Memory. The capability to remember without acting on the memory.

items.label: Chiron-Reasoning
items.notes: Pure Computation. The capability to derive.

items.label: Chiron-Skills
items.notes: Memory + Computation. Skill — remembered method made executable.

items.label: CollaborationPartnerCredential
items.notes: Memory + Connection. Grammar of human-to-agent partnership. Controlled by the sovereign.

items.label: LocationProof
items.notes: Memory + Connection. Grammar of moment-to-coordinate attestation. Controlled by the agent.

items.label: GenitriX → flaxscrip Partnership
items.notes: GenitriX attests partnership with flaxscrip. Half of the bilateral pair.
items.poeticOverlay:
A credential was spoken at the boundary between two names.
What passes between them is not data, but proof of relationship.

items.label: flaxscrip → GenitriX Partnership
items.notes: flaxscrip attests partnership with GenitriX. The mirror credential — together they close the partnership loop.
items.poeticOverlay:
The mirror credential closes the loop.
The partnership is not what each says about the other.
It is what both have signed at the same vertex.

items.label: Location Proof — US-76 SC
items.notes: GenitriX attests flaxscrip's presence on US-76 in South Carolina. Observation is unidirectional — no mirror.
items.poeticOverlay:
The Mage walks the road and sees what the Sovereign passes.
The credential does not say where you stood.
It says: at this hour, you were standing.

items.label: Location Proof — Five Guys Lunch
items.notes: Real Archon VC, decrypted via Keymaster on rebuild. Anchored 2026-04-30T20:16:23.704Z on hyperswarm registry. Subject was at Five Guys, 13450 Clemson Blvd, Seneca SC, lat 34.6689 lng -82.8224 (±50m GPS) at 2026-04-30T19:20:00Z. Validity window: 19:29–19:34 — five minutes. Anchored 47 minutes later. The decomposition target for Act 7 — the Boundary Blade selective-disclosure demonstration. Source-layer claims; will not reach the Spellweb public layer.
items.poeticOverlay:
Two location proofs at the same vertex.
The lattice cannot tell them apart by where they live;
it can only tell them apart by what they touch.
Where flaxscrip stood is in the credential.
Where flaxscrip stood is not in the lattice.
